more_info.overview: Propylparaben is the propyl ester of para-hydroxybenzoic acid, a chemically defined member of the paraben preservative family. Its preservative function is to limit microbial spoilage during storage. The available identity record does not establish a typical retail-food example for this exact preparation. Commercial specifications and legal conditions need to refer to the particular substance or preparation named here.
